basics.name: Giovanni Pellegrini
basics.label: AI Scientist
basics.summary: AI Scientist working on the creation and development of cutting-edge artificial intelligence products for businesses, using traditional machine learning and agentic AI systems.

work.name: Ipazia S.p.A.
work.summary: Design and development of AI products for businesses, combining traditional machine learning with agentic AI systems.
highlights: Data preprocessing, development and training of an algorithm to identify problematic users using time-series analysis for an international gambling platform.
Estimation of loan recovery rate of clients for an international financial institution.
Creation of a data preprocessing pipeline and recommendation algorithms to improve the match between candidates and job vacancies for a major Italian recruiting company.
Research and development of internal products based on agentic AI solutions using LangGraph and Autogen.

work.name: GlassFORM.ai
highlights: Development and training of machine learning algorithms to automatically control the parameters of glass forming machines in real time during production.
Presentation of AI solutions at GlassTEC 2022 fair.

work.name: University of Trento
highlights: Teaching assistant for the Machine Learning course at the master program in Computer Science.

work.name: TIM
highlights: Business project in collaboration with TIM on the recommendation of bundles of products and telecommunication services.

work.name: TIM
highlights: Research project on the fine-grained estimation of the position of tweets.

work.name: Trento RISE
highlights: Development of a web application with AngularJS at the TechPeaks startup incubator.
Scholarship sponsored by TIM and EIT Digital.
Supervision of the thesis of two Bachelor and one Master students.
Period abroad of 4 months at the University of Aalborg, Denmark.
Thesis: Neuro-Symbolic learning with Type Extension Trees.
